verdict.rationale: Buzz is a team chat and workspace product, so a workspace message-history export is a fair compliance question. The evidence pack documents no export feature, no compliance or eDiscovery tooling, and nothing on admin access to private conversations or DMs. The documented admin API covers moderation reports and product feedback, history search is described only as an agent capability, and an open Nostr protocol and self-hosted Postgres storage are not a documented export path.
